verdict.rationale: Bento is an agent observability platform, and a built-in assistant is a fair question for that kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no in-product assistant that accepts and carries out delegated tasks. The closest items are adjacent: plain-English signal and alert authoring, which are narrow natural-language features, and Agent Skills that run inside external coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
